## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, before/after behavior and any storage/API compatibility impact.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant behavior or fault-injection test included
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `jewelmentor evaluate --output runtime/evaluation.json`
- [ ] Documentation matches implementation
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or runtime databases

## Evidence and limitations

Include actual commands/results. Separate synthetic proxy scores from human or production outcomes.
